title: Nice, but…
text:
Nice, but…. Well, I liked the color(pink), because it looks so nice with my easter decoration and tablecloth.
The flowers look cute, but pedals can not open and the leaves are of another material that looks very fake.
I noticed in other older reviews, that at some point the leaves looked nice and more real…don’t understand why they changed them!

product_metadata.title: PU Fake Tulips Real Touch Artificial Flowers 10Pcs Flower Arrangement Bouquet for Home Office Wedding Decoration (White)
features: Material: Artificial tulip buds and leaves are made of high quality PU material. Stems are made of steel wire inside and PU outside. The tulip stem can be cut easily to fit different vases.
Size: total height is about 13.4”, and the bud is 1.2” diameter. A flower bud and two green leaves consist of one single stem.
Occasion: 10 stems (not include vase) are suitable for one flower arrangement. Same as fresh ones, you can use these real touch tulips for room, party and wedding decorations.
Standing for elegance, love and purity, the tulips can last for a long time and won’t droop. It is the best gift for all.
Tips: If there is dust on the tulip buds and leaves, you can use wet cloth to clean. Better not to put these tulips artificial flowers under sunlight too long.
